labels.name: SUPPORTED
labels.definition: The passage explicitly or unambiguously supports the proposed typed relation.

labels.name: NOT_SUPPORTED
labels.definition: The entities are valid in context, but the proposed relation is contradicted or not licensed by the passage.

labels.name: INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT
labels.definition: The candidate is semantically judgeable, but the supplied passage lacks enough evidence for a supported or not-supported decision.

labels.name: ENTITY_OR_TYPE_ERROR
labels.definition: At least one span, entity identity, or entity type makes the candidate invalid before relation assessment.

separate_model_action.name: ABSTAIN
separate_model_action.definition: A calibrated model action, not a human semantic label.
